paraphrase: Preview of the July 2026 Play Console requirements. To meet Android developer verification you must register your app package names in Play Console (effective September 30, 2026); most apps were registered automatically, but unregistered apps face global removal from Google Play. Developers must complete all Play Console requirements: choose the right account type (financial, health, VPN and government apps must register as an Organization), give accurate legal name, address, D-U-N-S number where applicable, contact details and payment profile, and keep them consistent with Dun & Bradstreet. Before submitting, provide accurate app metadata, a privacy policy and completed Data safety section, and a working demo account and any login resources reviewers need. Developer accounts may only change hands through the official account transfer process.
